contract: Each fixture in this directory is rendered through BOTH plan implementations: Python 1.x (scripts/use_cases/<use_case>.py -> profile.ops.render_shell) and Rust (crates/conwrt-core plan/profile pipeline, exposed via `cargo run -p conwrt-cli --bin conwrt-plan-render -- <fixture>`). The pytest harness (tests/test_parity_rust_plan.py) normalizes both outputs (drop shebang/set-e/comment/blank lines; shlex-tokenize each line; drop known-equivalent decorations 2>/dev/null, 'uci -q' quiet flag, trailing '|| true') and asserts the command streams are EQUAL. The cargo-side test (crates/conwrt-core/src/parity.rs) additionally asserts byte-equality of the filtered command lines against the Python-generated goldens in golden/ for every fixture marked EQUAL. The expected status below is the recorded parity state: if reality changes in either direction the tests fail until this manifest is updated in review — gaps close loudly, never silently.
